nav.title: Expand
nav.description: A click opens BELOW, in place. Nothing else moves and the url never changes.

nav.title: Launch
nav.description: A click opens a new column to the RIGHT. The page you clicked from stays exactly where it was.

nav.title: Swap
nav.description: A click replaces what is in the box. The box keeps its exact place on screen.

nav.title: Takeover
nav.description: One child fills the screen; everything behind it collapses into the trail above.
